# Maze wall: a dark wooden rail 2.0 m long (along x), 0.26 m thick, 0.45 m tall, its top orange.
# Origin at the centre of its foot (the game puts it on the tilting floor). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rail --base-color 0.5412 0.3451 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Top --base-color 0.8784 0.5529 0.3176 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Wall --size 1 --location 0 0 0.225
scale 2.0 0.26 0.45
apply --scale
material assign Rail
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Top
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export wall.glb
